name: Oxford Dictionaries
tagline: Premium lexical data from Oxford University Press
description: Oxford Dictionaries API provides dictionary definitions, translations, thesauri, and lexical data from Oxford University Press for English and other languages. Access headword lookups, senses, examples, pronunciations, and related linguistic data via REST endpoints for language apps, writing tools, and educational products.

auth.details: App ID and App Key via app_id and app_key headers after signup on the developer portal

example.response_snippet: {"id":"ace","metadata":{"operation":"retrieve"},"results":[{"id":"ace","language":"en-us","lexicalEntries":[{"entries":[{"senses":[{"definitions":["a playing card with a single spot"]}]}]}]}]}

use_cases: look up dictionary definitions for a word
retrieve example sentences for a sense
